knownLimitations: Single local administrator; no multi-user/remote hosting/OAuth
Loopback HTTP supported; HTTPS/proxy deployment not provided; Secure cookie flag is conditional on a TLS socket
CLI filesystem/recovery and MCP grants are explicit local-owner channels, independent from browser login
Browser create/import requires startup-approved root; there is no filesystem scanning or arbitrary file browser
Legacy CLI workspace initialization retains benchmark/development internal IDs; environment field is a display name
Saved provider choices require the same operator environment/approved executable for CLI/MCP startup; browser cannot install/authenticate providers
MCP diagnostics initializes a new pinned process; it does not inspect an existing external client
Old running viewer processes require restart to load Studio auth; old URL fragments are not accepted by Studio
Legacy bearer project servers remain private internal backends and old regression harnesses, not a publicly exposed CLI mode
Abrupt process/job/artifact reconciliation remains manual; active jobs are preserved during switching, not guaranteed after crashes
Linux Chromium validated only; benchmark measurements are local samples, not SLAs
Hosted CI not executed because no push/publication was authorized
